name: Stephen W.
preview: Sarah: Take care, Steven. Talk soon.

messages.text: Hey, Steven. Thanks for hopping on. I saw you went through a refund on the BitX Gamma 601 last week after a fair bit of back and forth. I'd love to hear how that whole experience went from your side.
It was, uh, pretty good. Experience. I was interested in having the device, but I had to refund due to the situation. Perfect.
Got it. What was the situation that pushed you toward the refund?
Family related.
Understood. So the device itself, were you still wanting it and life just got in the way?
Yeah.
Makes sense. So let me back up a bit. Pupoli. What originally got you interested in the BIDAC scamma? Like, what were you doing or reading that made you pull the trigger back in March?
I was reading a post about it online.
Do you remember where? Was it Reddit, Twitter, YouTube, somewhere else?
Twitter.
Nice. What about the post caught your eye? Was it the solo mining angle, the device itself, something else?
Still, um, manning.
Solo mining. Yeah. That's the dream. Right? Hitting a block on your own. So when you saw that post, had you already been into Bitcoin mining, or was the BitX kind of your entry point?
EBITDAX was the entry point.
Cool. So this would have been your first miner. When you were looking at the BitX Gamma v 3, did you have a sense of what 1.8 terahash actually meant in terms of your odds of hitting a block?
Yes.
What was your understanding? Like, were you going in eyes wide open that it's a lottery ticket? Or did you have different expectations?
Yes. The lottery ticket.
Love it. So you knew the deal going in. Now I noticed you ordered 2 of them. Was the idea to stack hash ready or were you planning to give 1 to somebody?
It's that hash rate.
Smart. Double up the tickets. So between when you ordered in mid March and when you reached out to support in April, what was going on? Were you just waiting on shipping or was something off?
Plate not shipping.
Got it. So you were waiting, and it hadn't shipped yet. When you reached out to support around April twelfth.
Let's go.
What did they tell you? How did that support conversation go? Did they give you a clear answer on the shipping delay?
No. No clear answer.

That's frustrating. So you waited another few weeks after that, and then I saw you came back pretty heavily on May eighth, like multiple chat sessions throughout the day. Was that the day you decided okay. Enough is enough?
Yes. Hello?
Yeah. I'm here. So on May eighth, were you hoping would happen when you started chatting that morning? Were you still trying to get it shipped, or had you already decided to cancel?
Oh, just had to cancel.
Got it. So by that point, the family situation had come up, and the shipping delay kind of sealed it. Was there a moment where if the order had shipped on time, you would have kept it to stuff?
Yeah.

So the delay really cost them the sale. That's helpful to know. Now I noticed that same day, May eighth, looked at the BitX Gamma v 2. The 1.5 terahash 1, and then again later that night after the refund went through. What was going through your head there?
Just debating on looking in it for the future purchase.
Makes sense. The v 2 is at a lower price point. 95 bucks. Was the lower cost part of the appeal, or was it more about just getting something simpler?
Lower cost.
Got it. So if things settle on your end, is that VT the 1 you'd go for, or would you still lean toward the v 3 if you had the budget?
I may lean more towards v 3.

Nice. So you still want the higher hash rate if you can swing it. That makes sense if you're playing the lottery, you want more tickets. Let me ask you this. When you were doing your research on Twitter and deciding what to buy, did you end up on the Helium Deploy site right away? Or did you shop around on other sites first?
I stopped around.
Where else did you look? Like, were you checking other stores that sell Bidax units or were you comparing totally different minors?
I was comparing different miners.
What else were you looking at? ASICs, other solo miners, something totally different.
Mainly other solo miners.
What made you go with the Bidax Gamma over the others you were looking at?
The price and the power of it, power consumption.
That's a good combo. Low power draw is huge. A Especially in Florida, I imagine your electric bill matters. Do you know roughly what the gamma pulls in watts?
It's a very low amounts.
Yeah. It's pretty sipping. When you landed on Helium Deploy's specifically to buy it, was there anything about the site that made you feel confident buying there versus somewhere else?
They seemed pretty transparent, good items, the support looked pretty valid. And it seemed very easy to reach out to.
That's interesting, especially since you ended up having to use that support a fair amount. How would you rate the actual support experience compared to what you expected going in?
It was pretty good. Hi, Raiden.

Good to hear. So the support itself was solid even if the shipping delay was frustrating. That's useful to know. 1 more thing I'm curious about, if you could go back and tell yourself something before you place that order in March, knowing what you know now. What would you say?
I would say hold off and give it a little more time than purchased it.
Because of the family stuff that came up or because of the shipping timeline, or both.
Definitely both.

That makes a lot of sense. Steven, this has been really helpful. You've given me a clear picture of what happened. Before I let you go, is there anything you wish Helium deployed did differently that would make you more likely to come back when you're ready?
I wish they had a call center that I could use to talk to someone on the phone with any issues I had.
That's great feedback. So when you were going back and forth in the chat on May eighth, you would have preferred to just pick up the phone and get it sorted in 1 call?
Yeah.

Makes total sense. Especially when you're cycling through tabs trying to get answers A phone call would have wrapped that up in minutes. Well, Steven, I really appreciate you taking the time. This was super helpful. And just so you know, you've got a 75 dollar store credit coming your way. So whenever you're ready to pull the trigger on that v 3 again, it'll take a nice chunk off. Thanks again, and best of luck with everything on the family side.
Awesome. Thank you.
Take care, Steven. Talk soon.
